studio.run.cont.join.fileBlocked: This video has blocking issues and cannot be joined.
studio.run.cont.join.addFailed: The video could not be copied to the backend.
studio.run.cont.stale: The plan changed while a step was starting; run it again.
studio.run.cont.noClip: The backend listed no new checkpoint for this step.
studio.run.opt.chunking.hint: Splits feed-forward activations to lower peak VRAM; the chunk count follows frames × canvas like the DaSiWa workflows. Pick your card's memory.
studio.run.opt.output.hint: Video encoding (DaSiWa Enhanced Video Combine): Auto prefers browser-friendly AV1/WebM, then VP9 and H.264. Image format and 0–100 compression apply to the DaSiWa image saver (0 = best quality).
studio.plan.notice: Live, read-only preview of the next Run. Edit settings in Generate. This is not a workflow editor or runtime progress.
studio.plan.validation: Native preparation revalidates this draft at Run; this preview does not prove model compatibility or generation readiness.
studio.plan.wildcardPending: Wildcard text resolves in the backend at Run; the base prompts and active rules are shown here.
studio.plan.audioPending: Audio is generated/conditioned by this family. Its effective sample rate and encoded stream are not yet resolved.
studio.plan.outputPending: Auto formats, final filenames, backend saver defaults and transferred files resolve at Run; this is not an export or overwrite confirmation.
studio.plan.mask: Mask upload pending; blur {blur} px, crop margin {grow} px, masked-area crop: {crop}. Crop geometry is captured at Run.
studio.plan.layersPending: Painted layers flatten and upload at Run; shown names/geometry are the current draft.
studio.plan.uploadPending: Selected external media uploads at Run; displayed source paths are not uploaded handles.
studio.plan.intent: Exact draft intent (upload handles and native defaults pending)
studio.plan.checkpointParts: From checkpoint; internal selection not inspected
studio.plan.imageOnly: Image-only refinement/wildcards/custom schedules are not applied by this video Run; H3 image edits also omit refinement.
studio.plan.nativePass: Native recipe resolves internal resize / pass defaults at Run
studio.run.prompt.prefillKinds: Prefill: read the RefMod library first (References tab), so each RefMod's media kinds are known.
studio.backend.unavailable: Backend not reachable. Start it under Backend. If it is already started, wait until it is ready, check the backend address and look in Logs.
studio.backend.timeout: The backend did not respond in time. It may still be starting or busy. Wait briefly and try again; check Backend and Logs if this continues.
studio.backend.requestFailed: The backend connection failed or was interrupted. Check its status and address under Backend, then try again. Details are in Logs.
studio.backend.httpError: The backend replied with HTTP {status}. Check Backend and Logs; verify the address and access settings, then try again.
studio.tve.title: TrueVideoEnhancer — video post-processing
studio.tve.needsSource: Inspect a source first (chooser or Media tile).
studio.videoPost.blocker.subtitlesUnsupp: Subtitles cannot be preserved by this draft.
studio.history.title: Recent generations
studio.history.help: The last 10 native attempts across projects and environments. History is metadata; older rows are removed without deleting files.
studio.history.native: Open the desktop app to read local history.
studio.history.failed: History could not be read. See Logs.
studio.history.readOnly: History is read only; new attempts may not be saved.
studio.history.inQueue: Recent attempts are already in the current queue.
studio.history.uncertain: This is a last-observed state, not a recovered live job. No automatic retry or cancellation is available.
studio.history.authoring: This changes authoring only. It never runs a generation.
studio.history.project: The active project keeps its autosave and unsaved-work notices. Its baseline draft will change; metadata cannot rebuild editor pixels or a complete project/session.
studio.history.replaceDraft: This replaces current authoring controls and clears the current editor input, mask, layers and references. Editor pixels and complete sessions cannot be reconstructed from metadata.
studio.history.partial: Review the partial restore before applying. Unresolved required inputs and omitted settings block Run. Historical filenames do not prove original media, even when a current file has the same name. Reselect inputs explicitly.
studio.history.unsupported: Cannot reconstruct in current authoring controls: {items}
studio.history.applied: Settings applied to the draft. No generation was submitted.
studio.history.draft: Draft uses historical settings. Exact seed is fixed.
studio.history.newDraft: Discard omitted settings and continue as a new draft
studio.history.inputReselect: History cannot prove the original input files. Choose source and last frame from Media, and replace unresolved references. Each selection is a new authoring choice.
studio.history.referenceReselect: Drop a Media image here, or preview a Media image and use it below. The reference keeps its order and strength.
studio.music.lyricsHint: Optional lyrics with section tags such as [Verse] and [Chorus]; empty for instrumental.
studio.music.needsSource: Select an audio file or a video with an audio track.
studio.music.needsEncoder: Select an installed SheetSage2 audio encoder.
studio.music.durationHint: Maximum only; the song may finish earlier.
studio.music.coverHint: Uses the source melody; does not copy the singer's voice or automatically transcribe lyrics.
studio.music.handoffBlocked: Prompt Forge sends image prompts; switch to an image pipeline or write Style and Lyrics with their own hammers.
studio.tve.post.title: TVE post-processing
studio.tve.post.badgeHint: Pulled from TrueVideoEnhancer; runs on the decoded frames before the final encode.
studio.tve.post.rtxMissing: The backend does not list the DaSiWa RTX node.
studio.tve.post.loopMissing: Seamless loop needs the DaSiWa node pack 0.5.41 or newer (DaSiWa_SeamlessLoop with audio). Update ComfyUI and the node packs via Backend.
studio.tve.post.loopAudioHint: Crossfade blends the end into the start; Beat-aware also picks a loop length of whole beats when the music has a clear tempo.
studio.tve.post.loopHint: The loop shortens the video (frames are trimmed for the loop); the Original stays saved.
studio.tve.post.fpsHint: {from} fps → {to} fps; the unprocessed video is kept as Original.
studio.tve.post.needsRifeModel: RIFE needs a frame interpolation model
studio.tve.post.needsStage: Enable at least one TVE stage.
studio.tve.post.baselineHint: The decoded video is encoded unchanged as Original; the processed result is a second file.
studio.tve.post.rtxMemoryHint: Only for long videos: use_mmap writes the complete RTX batch to disk when RAM is short; frames per chunk bounds SDK work, the whole batch still needs storage.
studio.tve.backendHint: Runs the TVE stages on the owned ComfyUI backend with the DaSiWa nodes; the source is copied to its input folder and the job appears in the Studio queue.
studio.tve.queueHint: Progress, preview and export: Studio queue.
studio.tve.jobGone: The job left the Studio queue before it settled; see Logs.
studio.tve.pick: Or pick a video from Media (input/output folders):
studio.run.viewer.closed: Open a generated picture in Full view first.
studio.run.exportClean.label: Export without metadata…
studio.run.exportClean.hint: Saves a copy without prompt, workflow or settings; the original is unchanged.
studio.run.exportClean.title: Export without metadata
studio.run.exportClean.native: Exporting without metadata requires a local file in the desktop app.
studio.run.exportClean.needs: Select a finished result with a local file first.
studio.run.derope.keepBackgroundHint: Blend the re-rendered motion with the original static areas using a soft motion mask. Camera movement may still change the background. Off by default.
studio.run.derope.keepBackgroundMissing: Needs compatible De-rope Recover inputs. Use Backend → Upgrade → ComfyUI and node packs, then restart the backend.
studio.run.derope.title: De-rope (fast motion)
studio.run.derope.hint: Second pass after the H3 generation: hot motion spans are slowed, re-rendered at partial denoise and sped back up. The unprocessed video is saved first. Costs roughly one more generation of the slowed length. Off by default.
studio.run.derope.missing: Needs the DaSiWa De-rope nodes (node pack 0.5.43 or newer). Update the node packs via Backend.
studio.run.derope.conflict: De-rope cannot continue a new segment from an imported video (its window is built inside the node pack); use Full timeline or a generated clip.
studio.run.derope.full: Generation model · 25 steps (6 when marked distilled)
studio.run.derope.distilledHint: Tick when the generation uses a turbo checkpoint or a turbo LoRA: the second pass then runs on that same chain, LoRA included, with the 6-step turbo schedule. Unticked runs 25 steps. Off by default.
studio.run.derope.loraHint: Applied to the second pass only, at strength 1.
studio.run.derope.needsLora: De-rope: choose a turbo LoRA or switch to the base model
studio.run.derope.injectHint: Share of the schedule re-run on the slowed clip: lower keeps more of the original, higher lets the model re-invent more.
studio.faceRefine.minFaceHint: Faces never taller than this keep their original pixels (0 = refine every face). A tiny face is upscaled to the 768 refine canvas and costs a full H3 pass for little detail.
studio.faceRefine.primaryOnlyHint: Refine only the largest tracked face in each shot (the main subject); other faces keep their original pixels. Off = every tracked face.
studio.run.post.reason.latentOnly: LTX-2 and MiniMax H3 video pipelines only.
studio.run.post.reason.audioManualOnly: Manual audio enhancement remains available; automatic run post-processing needs an audio-capable video or music pipeline.
